title: The home time zone is defined once, so a second region is a one-line change

verify.note: Fails before the change: eleven code sites carry the literal America/Los_Angeles.

detail: HOME_TZ existed in lib/time/zone.ts and HOME_TIME_ZONE in lib/events/time-zones.ts, yet eleven code sites (discovery search, Free Human events, site-events siteToday, device tag targets, browser-zone, day-grid-nav, calendar settings, feed, offer) repeated the literal. The same bug class as SCAN-1037, 1126 and 1191 comes from each site choosing its own zone. Now lib/time/home-zone.ts (no imports, so client files can take it) holds the one value; zone.ts keeps its own copy because a pinned dependency allowlist (event-zone-postgres probe) forbids a new import there. The Postgres default on events.time_zone and the zone label table stay as they are. Expected lift: opening a second region changes one value, and the next 'today' bug has one place to fix.
